CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   C. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
   D. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem The Growth of the Kingdom of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem Retrieving the Lost and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Acts of Apostles The Early Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
